_about: Which MCP tools a crew WORKER may be granted, per server. Only READ tools are listed: an unlisted tool is a write and is
never granted (deny by absence). `crew_spawn needs:['<server>:read']` generates the allowlist from these rows; nothing spells
'the whole server', and the `mcp` / `mcpScript` / `mcp__<server>` gateways are never granted because they dispatch to any tool.
Adding a server or tool: list its bare name (before the adapter's `<server>_` prefix) under `read` ONLY if it cannot post, send,
create, edit, delete, save, or dispatch. Seed from your mcp-cache.json: mcp({ server }).
